title: Paul Klee — a declared absence: the pictures, the Pädagogisches Skizzenbuch and the writings, held back by their number and by the rights in their photographs
edition: No edition held. The seat holds the declaration of what it would hold: declared/absence.json and declared/absence.md.

license.payload: The declaration is the archive's own, CC-BY-4.0. The works it names are not held.
license.record: CC-BY-4.0 applies to this seat record only.

normalization: None: the declaration is held as written.
scope: Declared, not seated: Paul Klee, Schöpferische Konfession, in Tribüne der Kunst und Zeit XIII (Erich Reiss, 1920), opens: open (published before 1931); Paul Klee, Pädagogisches Skizzenbuch (Bauhausbücher 2) (Albert Langen, 1925), opens: open (published before 1931); Paul Klee, Über die moderne Kunst (the Jena lecture of 1924) (Benteli, 1945), opens: 1 January 2041 in the United States, if its term was restored; Paul Klee, ed. Jürg Spiller, Das bildnerische Denken (Benno Schwabe, 1956), opens: the editor's apparatus under its own terms; Paul Klee, ed. Felix Klee, Tagebücher 1898–1918 (DuMont Schauberg, 1957), opens: the editor's apparatus under its own terms; Paul Klee, the pictures (about ten thousand works, 1883–1940), opens: the works open; the photographs under their holders' terms. Wanted, and open: the Pädagogisches Skizzenbuch (1925) and the Schöpferische Konfession (1920) in their first printings, with their drawings, from a scan whose licence is verified at the file. The pictures wait on a source whose images carry an open licence of their own.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-seventh seating entered Deleuze and Guattari as a declared absence: "and a declared absence/ wanted seating: hypatia, d & g, pkd, allen ginsberg, anne carson, and tao lin - including the mandalas. and paul klee. too many files and too many image copyright landmines." Paul Klee (1879–1940) is entered as wanted for a reason of his own: "too many files and too many image copyright landmines." His work runs to some ten thousand pictures, scattered across collections whose reproductions carry their own claims, and the shelf takes no file whose licence cannot be verified at the file.
ruling: A declared absence, the wanted seating: the works named, with their rights and opening dates, and no text (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
